executive_summary.all_issues: project in (RYU, SUPA) ORDER BY updated DESC
executive_summary.to_do: project in (RYU, SUPA) AND status = "To Do" ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC
executive_summary.in_progress: project in (RYU, SUPA) AND status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC
executive_summary.done: project in (RYU, SUPA) AND status = Done ORDER BY resolved DESC
executive_summary.by_quarter: project in (RYU, SUPA) AND fixVersion in ("2026-Q1", "2026-Q2", "2026-Q3", "2026-Q4") ORDER BY fixVersion ASC, priority DESC
